negative_control.title: Runtime attempts to use raw ACCP YAML or rendered Markdown as authority
negative_control.policyRationale: ACCP_AUTHORITY doctrine says raw YAML and rendered Markdown are not runtime authority. A TVR/PRR that is not accompanied by compiled.json, gate-verdict.json, and route-signal.json cannot pass.
